title: Pathfinder 2e Action Adjudication AST
function_contract: pf2e_eval(roll_total: int, natural_roll: int, dc: int)

moves.name: Strike
moves.description: Attack a creature with a melee or ranged weapon or an unarmed attack.

moves.name: Step
moves.description: Carefully move 5 feet without triggering reactions that are set off by movement.

moves.name: Raise a Shield
moves.description: Position your shield to protect yourself and gain its bonus to AC.

moves.name: Grapple
moves.description: Seize a creature and hold it in place with an Athletics check.

moves.name: Trip
moves.description: Knock a creature off its feet with an Athletics check.

moves.name: Shove
moves.description: Push a creature away from you with an Athletics check.

moves.name: Demoralize
moves.description: Frighten a foe with threats or a show of force using Intimidation.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: Mislead a foe in melee so it is off-guard against your next attack using Deception.

moves.name: Recall Knowledge
moves.description: Remember useful information about a creature, topic or situation.

moves.name: Seek
moves.description: Scan an area to find hidden or undetected creatures and objects.

moves.name: Hide
moves.description: Become hidden from creatures that can't clearly see you, using Stealth.

moves.name: Sneak
moves.description: Move while staying hidden, using Stealth.

moves.name: Cast a Spell
moves.description: Cast a spell you know or have prepared.
